sources.title: Articles on Smashing Magazine — For Web Designers And Developers

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Frederick O’Brien)
articles.description: Balancing the age-old simplicity of words on paper with the myriad creative possibilities of the web is a tension as old as the web itself. Leaning into that overlap can bring new dimensions not just to the things we write but also to how we write them.
articles.title: MDX Or: How I Learned To Stop Worrying And Love Multimedia Writing

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Juan Diego Rodríguez)
articles.description: Have you heard of the Screen Orientation API? What about the Device Orientation API, Vibration API, or the Contact Picker API? Juan Diego Rodriguez is interested in these under-the-radar web features and discusses how they can be used to create more usable and robust progressive web apps if and when they gain broader support.
articles.title: Uniting Web And Native Apps With 4 Unknown JavaScript APIs

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Vitaly Friedman)
articles.description: Job openings typically cast a very restrictive frame for candidates, with long lists of expectations and requirements. But what if this narrow focus can overlook the value of “V”-shaped designers who excel by crossing boundaries, connecting dots, and innovating beyond rigid boxes?
articles.title: T-Shaped vs. V-Shaped Designers

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Cosima Mielke)
articles.description: Whether you want to take your user research skills to the next level, get better at UX writing, or stay up-to-date on the latest design trends, a newsletter is the perfect opportunity to get the best of the best resources delivered straight to your inbox on a regular basis. In this post, we highlight some design newsletters that you might want to consider subscribing to.
articles.title: Useful Email Newsletters For Designers

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Juan Diego Rodríguez)
articles.description: What are these CSS Container Style Queries, and why should you use them? Juan Diego Rodríguez delves deeply into style queries, and not at the syntax level, but at what exactly they are solving and what sort of use cases you would find yourselves reaching for them in your work if and when they gain browser support.
articles.title: What Are CSS Container Style Queries Good For?

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Vitaly Friedman)
articles.description: The 2-page login pattern is becoming pervasive. Here are the reasons behind this design choice and alternative solutions to create a more efficient and user-friendly authentication experience.
articles.title: 2-Page Login Pattern, And How To Fix It

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Kristian Mikhel)
articles.description: Kristian Mikhel covers various practical applications of scents in product experience, from immersive entertainment to healing spaces and medical appliances, and how designers can drive innovation across spheres and disciplines.
articles.title: The Scent Of UX: The Unrealized Potential Of Olfactory Design

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Salma Alam-Naylor)
articles.description: Do perfect Lighthouse scores mean the performance of your website is perfect? As it turns out, Lighthouse is influenced by a number of things that can be manipulated and bent to make sites seem more performant than they really are, as Salma Alam-Naylor demonstrates in several experiments.
articles.title: How To Hack Your Google Lighthouse Scores In 2024

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Cosima Mielke)
articles.description: The times for CSS have probably never been more exciting than today. In this quick read, we’ve got some useful CSS tips and techniques for you that you can apply to your work right away. Let’s dive deeper into self-modifying CSS variables, hanging punctuation, and more.
articles.title: Useful CSS Tips And Techniques

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Victor Yocco)
articles.description: There’s more to achieving good UX than research and design. We need to effectively communicate our ideas to gain buy-in from key stakeholders. Victor covers how UX practitioners can harness the power of persuasion and other tactics from the field of communication when presenting research findings and design concepts to key stakeholders.
articles.title: Presenting UX Research And Design To Stakeholders: The Power Of Persuasion

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Addy Osmani)
articles.description: The web is still a young platform, and we’re only now beginning to recognize what “success” looks like for large projects. In his recent Smashing book, [Success at Scale](https://www.smashingmagazine.com/printed-books/success-at-scale/), Addy Osmani presents practical case studies featuring the web’s most renowned companies and their efforts to make big changes to existing apps and sites. In this article, Addy shows some of the key insights he has learned.
articles.title: Scaling Success: Key Insights And Practical Takeaways

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Cosima Mielke)
articles.description: Let’s kick off June with some fresh inspiration! Artists and designers from across the globe once again tickled their creativity to celebrate the beginning of the new month with a collection of beautiful and unique wallpaper calendars.
articles.title: Ice Cream Ahead (June 2024 Wallpapers Edition)

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Geoff Graham)
articles.description: What does it mean to learn the “basics”, or fundamentals, of front-end web development? Is starting with HTML and CSS still the best entry point to learn how to make websites and apps when we have a seemingly endless supply of frameworks? Geoff Graham thinks so and discusses why you might consider going “back to basics” to start or move forward in your career.
articles.title: In Praise Of The Basics

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Vitaly Friedman)
articles.description: Imagine finally resolving never-ending discussions about UI decisions for good. Here are some practical examples of decision trees for UI components and how to use them effectively. An upcoming part of [Smart Interface Design Patterns](https://smart-interface-design-patterns.com).
articles.title: Decision Trees For UI Components

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Atila Fassina)
articles.description: Application frameworks have built whole ecosystems on top of them. Let’s take a closer look at serverless platforms such as Netlify’s [Platform Primitives](https://www.netlify.com/platform/primitives) and explore how they can increase our productivity with a serverless fullstack experience.
articles.title: The Era Of Platform Primitives Is Finally Here

• I Indien gjorde hindunationalistiska BJP sitt sämsta parlamentsval på tio år och behöver nu förlita sig på koalitionspartier för att behålla regeringsmakten.

  • Ett av partierna som premiärminister Narendra Modi nu måste förlita sig på finns i delstaten Andhra Pradesh i sydöstra Indien.

  • Där vill man bland annat ha hjälp med att bygga en helt ny huvudstad.
articles.title: Modi måste förlita sig på parti – som vill bygga ny huvudstad

articles.description:
• Protesterna mot regeringen i Israel fortsätter runtom i landet. I går uppskattades uppemot 150 000 människor ha deltagit i demonstrationer i Tel Aviv, enligt en organisation som stöder protesterna.

  • Demonstranterna vill att regeringen ska sluta avtal med Hamas om vapenvila mot att gisslan som finns kvar i Gaza ska frisläppas.

  • Det som skiljer de senaste proteserna mot de tidigare är bland annat att de är större, men också att den politiska oppositionen nu anslutit sig.
articles.title: Samar Hadrous: Det utmärker de senaste protesterna i Israel

articles.description:
• I Grekland har ilskan varit stor sedan det blivit känt att det var fyrverkerier som avfyrats från en yacht som startat en skogsbrand på turistön Hydra på fredagen.

  • Fartyget har tagits i beslag av polisen och de 13 väntas ställas inför en åklagare inom kort – Grekland har nyligen skärpt straffen för dem som anlägger bränder som får dödlig utgång.

  • Myndigheterna i Grekland har varnar för att starka vindar och höga temperaturer gör risken för skogsbränder oerhört stor – särskilt i centrala Grekland.
articles.title: Tretton gripna efter fyrverkeribrand på turistö

articles.description:
• I onsdags hotade Hizbollahs ledare Cypern med konsekvenser, om landet fortsätter låta Israel använda militärbaser på ön vid ett eventuellt storskaligt krig mot Hizbollah.

  • Cypern svarar med att betona sin neutralitet i kriget i Gaza.

  • ”Viljan att starta ett storskaligt krig saknas, men allt kan förändras på fältet”, säger Kassem Hamadé, Expressens Mellanösternreporter.
articles.title: Hizbollah hotar Cypern efter upptrappad konflikt med Israel

articles.description:
• Inom EU väntar en strid om utrymmet på järnvägarna i Europa.

  • Kommissionen vill att gränsöverskridande godstrafik ska få ta plats på spåren och parlamentet är tydligt för en sådan förändring.

  • Men Ministerrådet vill värna det nationella inflytandet när det blir konkurrens mellan det långväga godset och persontrafiken i de länder som berörs.
articles.title: Tuffa förhandlingar om utrymmet på Europas järnvägar

articles.description:
• Polis och åklagare ser med stor oro på att AI-genererade bilder och filmer har börjat användas i utpressningssyfte inom den organiserade brottsligheten.

  • Ofta är brottsoffren unga pojkar, som tvingas att ta lån, köpa kryptovaluta eller köpa presentkort på nätet under hot.

  • Enligt Emelie Källfelt, åklagare vid Utvecklingscentrum i Göteborg, kan det gå väldigt illa när barn skuldsätter sig.
articles.title: AI-porr används för utpressning – offren ofta unga pojkar

articles.description:
• Delar av USA är drabbat av en ovanligt tidig värmebölja och många temperaturrekord har slagit den senaste veckan.

  • De senaste dagarna har en kupol av het luft parkerat över delar av östkusten och mer än 100 miljoner amerikaner bor i områden där varningar utfärdats för hälsorisker.

  • Flera platser i världen är just nu drabbade av extremvärme och forskare menar att det finns ett samband mellan klimatförändringarna och de höga temperaturerna.
articles.title: USA:s östkust drabbad av ovanligt tidig värmebölja

articles.description:
• I Frankrike är det parlamentsval och val av ny premiärminister söndagen den 30 juni. Valet utlystes efter ytterhögerpartiet Nationell samlings stora framgångar i EU-valet.

  • Enligt EU-kommissionen är Frankrike ett av de EU-länder som är mest utsatta för ryska påverkanskampanjer.

  • ”Det är en otrolig press från Ryssland gentemot Frankrike”, säger Vera Joureva, EU-kommissionens vice ordförande med ansvar för demokrati, värderingar och transparens.
articles.title: Franskt val utsatt för rysk påverkan: ”En otrolig press”

articles.description:
• Kriminalvården har fått fram 800 nya häktes- och anstaltsplatser sedan i mars. Men stabsläget förlängs till september eftersom ytterligare 40 platser i veckan behövs.

  • De nya platserna har främst tillkommit genom dubbelbeläggning av celler.

  • Stabschefen Joakim Righammar konstaterar att jakten på nya anstaltsplatser ibland tangerar lagens gränser. Även Justitieombudsmannen, JO, kritiserar överbeläggningarna.
articles.title: Anstalterna redan fulla – 40 nya platser i veckan ska fram

articles.description: For the first time, a phenomenon astronomers have long hoped to image directly has been captured by the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope’s Near-InfraRed Camera (NIRCam). In this stunning image of the Serpens Nebula, the discovery lies in the northern area of this young, nearby star-forming region.
articles.title: Webb snaps first image of aligned jets from newborn stars

articles.description: ESA’s XMM-Newton and NASA’s Chandra spacecraft have detected three young neutron stars that are unusually cold for their age. By comparing their properties to different neutron star models, scientists conclude that the oddballs’ low temperatures disqualify around 75% of known models. This is a big step towards uncovering the one neutron star ‘equation of state’ that rules them all, with important implications for the fundamental laws of the Universe.
articles.title: Too young to be so cool: lessons from three neutron stars

articles.description: Detecting faint objects close to bright stars is incredibly difficult. Yet, by combining data from ESA's Gaia space telescope with ESO’s GRAVITY instrument on the ground, scientists managed just that. They captured the first light signals of so far unseen dim companions of eight luminous stars. The technique unlocks the tantalising possibility to capture images of planets orbiting close to their host stars.
articles.title: Scientists spot hidden companions of bright stars

articles.description: The hyperactive sunspot region responsible for the beautiful auroras earlier in May was still alive and kicking when it rotated away from Earth’s view. Watching from the other side of the Sun, the ESA-led Solar Orbiter mission detected this same region producing the largest solar flare of this solar cycle. By observing the Sun from all sides, ESA missions reveal how active sunspot regions evolve and persist, which will help improve space weather forecasting.
articles.title: Can't stop won't stop: Solar Orbiter shows the Sun raging on

Using the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope, scientists have found a record-breaking galaxy observed only 290 million years after the Big Bang.
Over the last two years, scientists have used the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope to explore what astronomers refer to as cosmic dawn – the period in the first few hundred million years after the Big Bang where the first galaxies were born. These galaxies provide vital insight into the ways in which the gas, stars, and black holes were changing when the Universe was very young. In October 2023 and January 2024, an international team of astronomers used Webb to observe galaxies as part of the JWST Advanced Deep Extragalactic Survey (JADES) programme. Using Webb’s NIRSpec (Near-Infrared Spectrograph), scientists obtained a sp…
articles.title: Webb finds most distant known galaxy

articles.description:

			00:03:29
				
Mars’s surface is covered in all manner of scratches and scars. Its many marks include the fingernail scratches of Tantalus Fossae, the colossal canyon system of Valles Marineris, the oddly orderly ridges of Angustus Labyrinthus, and the fascinating features captured in today’s video release from Mars Express: the cat scratches of Nili Fossae.
Nili Fossae comprises parallel trenches hundreds of metres deep and several hundred kilometres long, stretching out along the eastern edge of a massive impact crater named Isidis Planitia.
This new video features observations from Mars Express's High Resolution Stereo Camera (HRSC). It first flies northwards towards and around these large trenches, showing their fractured, uneven appearance, before turning back to head southw…
articles.title: Fly across Nili Fossae with ESA’s Mars Express
